fatal_errors: The hypothesis substitutes single-phase NbTaTiV for the target as-cast, dual-BCC WTaTiVZr alloy and therefore omits the W-Ta-rich dendrite/Zr-Ti-rich interdendritic structure central to the reported material.
It replaces the commercial coarse-grained, powder-sintered tungsten baseline with an unspecified conventional BCC alloy.

The proposed temperatures up to 900 °C and neutron-diffraction experiment do not reconstruct the target's room-temperature compression, room-temperature-to-500 °C indentation, or room-temperature scratch-toughness tests.

Neutron diffraction cannot directly resolve a wavy dislocation-core configuration; the claimed structural mediator would require appropriate microscopy or atomistically validated indirect observables.
The cited evidence concerns strength and deformation of NbTaTiV but, as provided, does not establish lattice-distortion-induced edge-core waviness or improved fracture toughness.

The prediction of reduced plastic strain conflicts with the target observation that WTaTiVZr develops substantially greater plastic strain with increasing temperature and a lower apparent brittle-to-ductile transition than tungsten.
explanation: The response addresses the broad topic of high-temperature deformation in refractory high-entropy alloys and offers a nominally falsifiable comparison, but it reconstructs a different alloy system, baseline, temperature regime, and characterization program. Lattice distortion overlaps only with one interpretation of the target alloy's high strength; the target's toughness and plasticity were instead tentatively associated with Ti, V, and Zr effects, localized plasticity, grain-boundary cohesion, and crack impediment in a segregated two-phase microstructure. The proposed composition comparison also cannot cleanly isolate lattice distortion because changing chemistry simultaneously changes bonding, elastic constants, valence-electron concentration, diffusion, and dislocation energetics. Its evidence does not support the specific core-level or toughness claims, so it is not yet a well-supported plausible alternative.
